note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our on-premises file and email servers reach end of support next year. Replacing the servers, with three years of support, is quoted at $234,000. A cloud office suite would cost $22 per user a month for our 250 staff.

answers.common.decision: Whether to replace the servers or move to the cloud suite; the managing partner decides.
answers.common.audience: The managing partner and our two IT staff.
answers.common.materials: The cloud provider quoted a one-off migration of $30,000. We compare everything over 36 months.
answers.consulting.current-state: Our two IT staff patch the servers by hand. We had 3 outages last year.
answers.consulting.success: Fewer outages, staff able to work from any office, and spend within budget.
answers.consulting.constraints: A budget of $240,000 over the comparison period; our two IT staff stay.
